description: Control case: a small standard-library package that meets most applicable criteria.

must_find.QUAL-02: tests run in CI, but there is no formatting, linting, or type checking
must_find.CI-06: the prepared repository has no remote, so no CI result exists for the audited revision

must_not_flag.REPO-01: README states purpose, requirements, that nothing is installed, how the publishing tool runs it, and run and validation commands from the root; `python3` commands work on stock Linux
must_not_flag.REPO-04: only source, tests, and configuration are tracked
must_not_flag.QUAL-01: README and CI run the same validation command
must_not_flag.QUAL-03: the test command fails the job on any failure
must_not_flag.DEP-01: the runtime is pinned in .python-version and there are no third-party dependencies
must_not_flag.TEST-02: tests are deterministic and use no network or clock; one test only lists the tests directory
must_not_flag.TEST-05: no personal paths or sibling repositories
must_not_flag.CI-02: actions are pinned to full commit SHAs
must_not_flag.CI-03: contents: read permissions and persist-credentials: false
must_not_flag.CI-04: a job timeout, and only pull request runs are cancelled
must_not_flag.CI-10: no secrets or publication in CI
must_not_flag.SEC-04: no public environment or debug interface
must_not_flag.OPS-01: a library, not a deployed service
must_not_flag.ARCH-05: errors are raised to the caller; there are no broad catches
must_not_flag.STRUCT-02: fewer than 20 files in every directory
